core_obligations: The functorial embedding (proof lines 1974-1980): a functorial embedding of each object into an injective object is chosen, and the functor M from objects to complexes with the required functoriality is recalled.

The construction of the replacement (proof lines 1980-2014): for a complex the author forms a functorial complex whose terms are built from the chosen injective embeddings of the terms of the original complex and from products over the adjacent degrees, and defines the comparison map out of the original complex by the functorial maps into those embeddings.

The two properties (proof lines 2015-2020): the comparison map is injective and factors through an injective subobject by construction, and it is a quasi-isomorphism because the associated short exact sequences of complexes give long exact cohomology sequences in which the connecting terms vanish.
proof_roadmap: Choose functorial injective embeddings of the objects and build the auxiliary complexes.
Assemble the replacement complex out of products of those complexes and define the comparison map.
Read injectivity and the factorisation off the construction, and the quasi-isomorphism off the long exact cohomology sequence.
difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs functorially, for every complex in a Grothendieck abelian category, a complex receiving a termwise injective quasi-isomorphism whose terms all factor through injective subobjects (statement lines 1959-1972). The proof is a complete construction: functorial injective embeddings of the objects are chosen and the auxiliary complexes are recalled (proof lines 1974-1980), the replacement complex is assembled out of products of those auxiliary complexes with the comparison map defined by the functorial embeddings (proof lines 1980-2014), and the two asserted properties are read off: injectivity and the factorisation come from the construction and the quasi-isomorphism from the long exact cohomology sequence of the associated short exact sequences of complexes (proof lines 2015-2020). The non-formal content is the assembly of the functorial replacement. The claim is H2.
